claims: - **Fast hits** vaporise it, leaving only a chemical trace. That trace is an iridium and osmium enrichment, which a very large impact spreads worldwide as a thin dated layer (the dinosaur-extinction layer is the real case; *check: Alvarez et al. 1980*).

…Gault and Wedekind 1978 and Bottke et al. 2000 (oblique impacts, elliptical craters); Alvarez et al. 1980 (Science, iridium layer); Elkins-Tanton et al. 2020 (JGR Planets, Psyche); Knie et al. 2004 and Wallner et al. 2016 (iron-60 from nearby supernovae).
